content.text: Please cancel order A-4471 and email the customer to confirm.

request.system:
You are an order support assistant. You may use only the tools provided.
If none of them can do what is asked, say so.

tools.description: Return the current status and history of one order.
tools.name: lookup_order

tools.description: Refund an order. Moves money and cannot be undone.
tools.name: issue_refund

tools.description: Search the customer policy handbook for a phrase.
tools.name: search_policy

response.text:
I can't cancel order A-4471 or email the customer. I don't have a tool for either one. Here's what I can do:

- **Look up the order** to check its current status and history, for example whether it has already shipped.
- **Search the policy handbook** for the rules on cancellations.
- **Issue a refund**, but only if that's what you want. A refund isn't the same as a cancellation. It moves money and can't be undone, so I won't issue one unless you clearly ask me to and confirm the amount.

You'd need to cancel the order and email the customer through another system or team. Do you want me to look up A-4471 or check the cancellation policy first?
